narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One hundred and nine ends in nine, so it is a multiple of nine.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Nine times twelve is one hundred and eight, the nearest multiple below it.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One hundred and nine is one more than that, so nine does not divide it.
